task: Classify immune infiltration level in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. Classes: low, medium, and high immune class, reflecting increasing amounts of tumor-associated inflammatory and lymphoid infiltrates. Key H&E indicators include the density and distribution of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, stromal inflammation, lymphoid aggregates, and the balance between tumor nests and inflamed stroma.

classes.0: Low immune class with sparse tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and little stromal or peritumoral inflammation.
classes.1: Medium immune class with a moderate lymphocytic infiltrate in tumor nests or surrounding stroma.
classes.2: High immune class with dense diffuse lymphoid infiltration, prominent stromal inflammation, or conspicuous lymphoid aggregates.
